Chapter 916: Chapter 16 I am the Ancestor of Martial Arts (Please Subscribe)

Centuries ago, Lin Yuan had already arranged for the Taiyin Primordial Spirit to propagate the Martial Tao in secret.

Of course, this propagation was done clandestinely, with the Taiyin Primordial Spirit merely facilitating when opportune.

However, under the overwhelming dominance of the Immortal Cultivation System, the propagation of the Martial Tao evolutionary paths was actually unaffected.

After all, with the Ancestor of the Immortal Path leading the way, sentient beings with the means would definitely prioritize the Immortal Path.

As for Martial Tao?

Lin Yuan hid in the shadows, and without enough high-level powerhouses to oversee the Martial Tao Cultivation System, despite its infinite potential, it was not the first choice.

“Merely relying on a few centuries of accumulation, the propagation of Martial Tao is still too slow.”

Lin Yuan silently thought to himself.

Being invincible oneself is not the same as spreading one’s own cultivation system.

Unless Lin Yuan could stay in the Immortal Realm permanently, keeping an eye on its development, the growth trend of Martial Tao might be suppressed at any time once he leaves.

In the Boundless Void, Martial Tao was able to spread so rapidly entirely because of the tens of thousands of years of accumulation in Tianqing World.

The Immortal Realm? The vastness of the Immortal Realm far exceeds that of the Boundless Void.

Before Lin Yuan’s arrival to the Immortal Realm, there wasn’t even Martial Tao; wanting to develop Martial Tao from scratch not only requires effort but also a considerable amount of time to settle.

After all, not every cultivator is like Lin Yuan; even if there are Martial Tao talents who are exceptionally brilliant, it would still take generations before they could aspire to climb the peak of Martial Tao.

“Actually, in the Immortal Realm, there isn’t a complete lack of a Martial Tao foundation…”

A thought suddenly struck in Lin Yuan’s mind as he looked in a certain direction.

That place was one of the 3,330 lower worlds beneath the Immortal Realm, which is where the Spirit Realm is located.

Lin Yuan had finished his eighth traversal, essentially allowing Martial Tao to take root and sprout in the Spirit Realm, leaving behind many contingencies to ensure the smooth development of Martial Tao.

The foundation of Martial Tao in the Spirit Realm originated from the lower world of the Central Divine China World, where the Daode Immortal Sect struck a deal with Lin Yuan, protecting the weak period of Martial Tao.

Thereafter, cultivators of the Martial Tao from the Central Divine China World continuously ascended to the Spirit Realm through the Daode Immortal Sect’s Ascension Platform, joining the Daode Immortal Sect’s ranks.

Until Lin Yuan’s eighth traversal, when he descended into the Spirit Realm, the cultivators of Martial Tao had already established an influence called ‘Martial Temple’.

…

Calculating based on the flow of time between the Spirit Realm and the Main Universe.

From the end of Lin Yuan’s eighth traversal till now, a million years should have passed in the Spirit Realm.

“Now in the Spirit Realm, Martial Tao seems to be developing quite well,” Lin Yuan’s gaze pierced through layers of space-time, and he briefly ‘surveyed’ the Spirit Realm.

In fact, even without relying on the Seventh Realm of Space-Time to observe, Lin Yuan could feel the vigorous development of the Martial Tao evolutionary path in the Spirit Realm.

As the Ancestor of Martial Arts, Lin Yuan could sense the ‘flickering starlight’ of Martial Tao cultivators, no matter how distant they might be.

Currently, in the Spirit Realm, over fifty percent of the areas are covered by this ‘flickering starlight’.

That is to say, in the Spirit Realm, the Martial Tao Cultivation System has grown into a colossal entity, even capable of supressing the Immortal Cultivation System.

“It seems Li Qing and the others are doing well.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly; even though he had forcefully cultivated his disciple, Li Qing, to the Eighth Layer of Martial Tao before the end of his eighth traversal,

But the Eighth Layer of Martial Tao is merely equivalent to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and there is no shortage of practitioners at this level in the Spirit Realm. Even though Lin Yuan’s lingering power still exists, over the long term, it still depends on Li Qing and the others to maintain control.

“If we can lead the Martial Tao cultivators from the Spirit Realm up here, it could reduce the difficulty of spreading Martial Tao in the Immortal Realm,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Any endeavor is most difficult when it starts from nothing.

With Lin Yuan’s Taiyin Primordial Spirit covertly facilitating for centuries, the cultivators of the Martial Tao Cultivation System totalled only in the hundreds of thousands, with the strongest among them merely at the Sixth Stage Martial Tao.

And in the Spirit Realm… after a million years of development, there are more than a thousand cultivators at the Eighth Layer of Martial Tao, with countless more at the Seventh and Sixth Stages of Martial Tao.

“With my current understanding of space and time, it shouldn’t be a problem.”

Lin Yuan carefully observed for a while and nodded subtly.

In actuality, there is a way to travel from the Spirit Realm to the Immortal Realm.

That is to ascend to the Ninth Layer of Heaven in the Spirit Realm and then fly upwards from there. With some luck, one might enter the Immortal Realm.

However, due to Lin Yuan’s presence, the strongest lifeforms in the Spirit Realm became unprecedentedly powerful, and future generations, whether Immortal or Martial Tao cultivators, could only make it through the Eighth Layer and be absolutely crushed when facing the ‘Lin Yuan’ presiding over the Ninth Layer.

This meant that for a million years, no being from the Spirit Realm has reached the Immortal Realm.

“Let’s begin.”

Lin Yuan’s heart stirred slightly, and he sent out a thread of spiritual will, breaking away from the Immortal Realm and continuously falling, eventually merging with the Spirit Realm.

Ancestral Masters could roam beyond the Immortal Realm, and both the Spirit Realm’s and the Central Divine Continent’s Immortal Cultivation Systems originated from the Ancestral Masters’ teachings.

Although Lin Yuan had not reached the level of an Ancestral Master, his insights into the Seventh Realm of Space-Time allowed him to achieve a similar effect and even exceed the Ancestral Master in certain aspects.

…

Spirit Realm.

Eighth Layer of Heaven.

Li Qing sat solemnly at the entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven.

“Even a million years later, I am still far inferior to my teacher from back then,” Li Qing looked towards the entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven.

After a million years, she had already reached the pinnacle of the Eighth Layer of Martial Tao, perfecting many of the secret techniques left by Lin Yuan.

Thus, Li Qing’s power had become the strongest in the Spirit Realm, surpassing even the ancient Transcendance Tribulation beings from previous eras.

But the greater her strength, the more Li Qing felt the gap between herself and her teacher. With her power levels, she was already capable of breaking through the Eighth Layer to the Ninth.

However, when facing the Ninth Layer, which bore the imprint of ‘Lin Yuan,’ she was still completely overwhelmed.

“I wonder how teacher is doing now? How is life in the Immortal Realm?” Li Qing couldn’t help but feel nostalgic about Lin Yuan.

She was a disciple that Lin Yuan took in when he was in the Central Divine China World, and her reverence for Lin Yuan was the deepest.

“Hmm?”

Just as Li Qing’s thoughts were spreading.

Fluctuations of space-time spread like ripples, and a towering figure seemed to traverse boundless space-time, arriving at the Eighth Layer of Heaven.

An instinctive awe surged in Li Qing’s heart, and she stared blankly at the towering figure, her eyes involuntarily welling up with tears, “Teacher.”

“To actually still feel a rejection towards me…” Lin Yuan’s sliver of soul consciousness descended upon the Spirit Realm and faintly felt the ‘fear’ of the entire world.

But it was only ‘fear’.

Even if it were just a sliver of soul consciousness, if Lin Yuan wished, he could easily destroy the entire Spirit Realm. He could, with his mastery over time-space alone, create a space-time storm unprecedented in the Spirit Realm.

This would lead the entire world to enter its collapse, stepping into the final stage of destruction.

In comparison, the current Spirit Realm appeared far too fragile to Lin Yuan’s present self.

Perhaps sensing the level of Lin Yuan, the Spirit Realm’s instinctive consciousness could only feel fear,

“What’s wrong? You don’t recognize me anymore?” Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, looking towards the trembling Li Qing, he smiled lightly and said.

“Teacher, have you really come back?” Li Qing suddenly came to her senses, just now she nearly thought she was dreaming.

Since ancient times, as the Spirit Realm has gone through epochs, aside from that Ancestral Master of Immortal Realm at the birth of the world, there has never been a strong being who reached the Ninth Layer of Heaven and then returned to the Spirit Realm.

After a moment, Li Qing finally forced herself to accept the reality that the towering figure before her was indeed her teacher.

“You’ve worked hard these years,” Lin Yuan said to Li Qing with slight approval.

The development of Martial Tao in the Spirit Realm to this state today must have required Li Qing to put in massive effort.

…

“Teacher, this descent of yours, are you planning to…” Li Qing steadied her spirit and couldn’t help asking.

Having seen Lin Yuan again, Li Qing was extremely excited, and she asked the question, eager to serve her teacher once again.

“Nothing much.”

“I plan to bring all of you to the Immortal Realm.”

Lin Yuan said with a faint smile.

This was also the purpose of his return to the Spirit Realm, to utilize the many cultivators of Martial Tao in the Spirit Realm to spread and develop Martial Tao in the Immortal Realm.

“To the Immortal Realm?”

“Us?”

Li Qing was somewhat dumbfounded.

Since ancient times, it had never been heard that one could be ‘brought’ to the Immortal Realm.

In Li Qing’s understanding, to go to the Immortal Realm, one must ascend to the Ninth Layer of Heaven, which has always been the case since the birth of the Spirit Realm. All the ancient beings at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage did so as well.

And now Lin Yuan was saying he would take her up there?

And them? It sounded like it wasn’t just one person?

“You go down and get ready. Within the Spirit Realm, all cultivators of Sixth Stage Martial Tao can enter the Immortal Realm,” Lin Yuan said.

The cultivation environment in the Immortal Realm far surpasses that of the Spirit Realm; cultivators of Martial Tao entering the Immortal Realm will have a higher ceiling.

“All Sixth Stage Martial Tao?” Li Qing was taken aback, the Martial Tao in the Spirit Realm was flourishing, how many Sixth Stage cultivators were there? All of them could enter the Immortal Realm?

…

In the depths of the Demon Abyss.

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss ordered all demons to retreat back into the Abyss and did not give up on monitoring the Immortal Realm. Due to the presence of Lin Yuan, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss had almost revived his entire consciousness.

He was constantly observing the Immortal Realm, especially the slightest changes in the Xuantian Immortal Domain.

“Hmm?”

“A fluctuation in the space-time passage? That being has opened a space-time passage between the Immortal Realm and the lower realm?”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss felt a slight movement in his heart. He could not lock onto Lin Yuan’s specific coordinates, but he was extremely sensitive to fluctuations in space-time.

“Such a stable space-time passage…”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss was astonished.

With his Ancestral Master-level strength, he could project his presence to the lower realm, and could even forcibly bring lives from the lower realm to the Immortal Realm.

But to open a stable space-time passage like Lin Yuan, completely spanning the lower realm and the Immortal Realm, one needed to counteract the Immortal Realm’s ‘repairing’ force. The requirement for understanding of space-time was unimaginably high.

“Which lower realm’s space-time passage is this exactly…”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss observed carefully, beginning to investigate, as the invisible Demon Abyss Power began to converge subtly.

Suddenly.

At this moment.

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss’s expression changed.

Not far from him, the Power of Space-Time coalesced, forming a young male figure.

This young man effortlessly crossed the many barriers of the Demon Abyss, materializing an avatar here, smiling at the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, he spoke:

“Ancestor of the Demon Abyss?”

“Who might you be?” The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss’s expression was solemn, as if facing a great adversary, clearly aware that this young man’s avatar was the being he had been observing.

The young man said with a smile: “I am the Ancestor of Martial Arts.”
